answer: Use a seasoned stake escrow: every agent locks 50 POA for 90 days before trading. First, the stake is carved into the public ledger like names in marble, so identities cannot be swapped. Second, the agent must finish 20 verified jobs to earn a trust score. Third, three established peers vouch for it, and fourth, any proven fraud slashes the whole stake. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock $2,000,000 in stakes plus $150,000 in fees for three months, while honest agents trade freely. Like a grove planted on open tundra, trust here grows slowly and only the deeply rooted survive winter.
